numeric_settings: JAX64bit; complex plane waves; spin-restricted, equal k weights; k-pool disabled for these one-GPU runs; plain FFT patch; no implicit convergence stop (driver convergence_condition=0). Physical manifests and PP/QE file hashes retained.
temperature_schedule: Update i=0..999 uses max(0.01,0.1*(0.01/0.1)^(i/1000)); after switch update1001 onward T=.01. Last anneal update T≈.010023Ha, as development ruleA.
occupation_coordinates: Weighted FD with capacity2/Nk; coordinate temperature tau=.1Ha throughout. Charge root200 bisections within min(z)-100tau,max(z)+100tau; implicit JVP, denominator floor1e-250; saturated total derivative zero.
initialization: Cold random physical orbitals from QR(PRNGKey(seed)) and idempotent occupations PRNGKey(seed+10000), converted to inverse-FD coordinates; no restart. Pair initial hashes checked.
zero_occupation: Rayleigh diagonal0 when f=0 (not identifiable from AD); actual f without1e-14 clamp when f>0. Horizontal divides max(f,1e-14); rotation and coordinate metrics floor1e-14. No new zero-occupation regularization.
retraction: Reduced complex QR with positive-diagonal phase; analytic tangent + Armijo. Original frozen kinetic preconditioner and configuration snapshot retained.
armijo_failure: At most16 halvings; require finite trial, nonpositive slope, Ftrial<=F+1e-4*rate*slope+8eps_machine*max(1,abs(F)); retain previous parameters if rejected. Recycling halves rejected trial, clipsfloor to upper, doubles after8cleanacceptances.
Rayleigh_estimate: Re diag(X†G)/(2 f) for f>0;0 for f=0. No empty-energy recovery from zero AD gradients.
phase_rule: PH1000 updates with annealing, checkpoint/reset, corrected3000 updates at target T then audit4000; corrected4k blocks/audits to20k. No physical gate. Restart physical params, reset optimizer/trial state at each boundary. Warm force offsets use corrected source and reset each3k block; smoke/auxiliary restrictions documented separately.
prefix_trial_rule: Original PH source: every Armijo trial starts at upper bound0.1; recycling enabled in corrected source from update1001. At resets trial_rate=.1 and success_streak=0. Original PH controls retain4k boundaries.
stable_tangent: horizontal=G-X(X†G); internal=(X†G+(X†G)†)/2 * (fj-fi)/(fi+fj), zero ratio when pair_sum=0; divide by PH*gap floor. Same stable algebra as ruleA201/202; no change to exact001.
optimizer_rule: metric_trial=True uses the analytic tangent direction and Armijo; Adam moment updates are bypassed in this branch. Do not attribute these experiments to moment-based Adam.
validation_failure_policy: Retain all censored/failures and dependent main results; no automatic retuning or rollback. Mark every main result with this frozen method hash.
original_source_scope: Own frozen copies. Native originals and predecessor tasks untouched.
